# Radio Button

Select one option from several choices.
See [Radio Button guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/radio-button/design/)

The `ds-radio` class is a simple container for:

- a radio input
- a label

<Canvas of={RadioStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Sizes

The radio comes in 2 sizes: medium (default), or large.
